limitations: The matched small padded16 source model has 46 named ANE hardware prediction events.
Full-image variants have compute plans and complete timing; attempts to attach an additional full-image trace failed with process-discovery/device-boot errors.
TensorOps kernels executed on A20 Pro GPU. Public counter sets exposed GPUTimestamp only; Metal trace gpu-counter-info had zero rows. No dedicated GPU Neural Accelerator occupancy claim.

probe.scope: Phone synthetic point-stage timing plus full native color/gradation/sharpness/finish error propagation; not full RAW/HEIF timing.

budget.scope: Additional acceleration error relative to the existing validated production recipe; vendor residuals reported separately.
budget.rationale: Conservative screening below an approximately one-unit visible color difference; not a universal perceptual guarantee. HDR ITP uses ITU-R BT.2124 scaling. Budgets fixed before candidate measurement; approximations do not replace defaults without a reviewed budget and complete pipeline benefit.

build_manifest.study: Source matrix Core ML and Metal TensorOps candidates; production sources referenced without modifying original color code.
build_manifest.orchestration_note: run.py added a second activation of the already-launched app during its initial wait; full-run command lists record this. Compiled app/shader code did not change after the final probe.

limits: One retained RAW and three warm repetitions, not a general latency or p95 guarantee.
Profiler runs and diagnostic retries are excluded from latency statistics.
Prediction/submit time includes framework work and synchronization, not exclusive accelerator execution time.
Synthetic color tests do not substitute for final HEIF accuracy.
No power/energy measurement or sustained camera workload test.
